d: In this video, we explore one of the most critical and controversial issues between India and Pakistan — Can India really block Pakistan’s water? The Indus River (also known as the Sindhu River) has been at the heart of India-Pakistan water disputes for decades. The Indus Waters Treaty of 1960, brokered by the World Bank, has allowed both countries to share the waters of the Indus River system, but tensions are rising. Is it possible for India to suspend or even block Pakistan’s water supply from the Indus River?
